notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Here's the announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=ACNcnQR7-1I;full][/previewyoutube]

It's slightly annoying timing since I'm devoting the next couple weeks to the Pirate Software Jam to create something fresh. Fish Hero has been in the works for a few months, but it's time to move forward onto the next dev journey. It's our first Steam launch but we won't be stopping no matter if the game gets no sales (although it would be slightly frustrating no?)

Thanks for checking out the game anyway even if it's not your cup of tea!
Henry
